blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Property & Casualty — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the property & casualty operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it. Both are decision factories — rate against exposure and catastrophe models, settle against policy language and fraud signals — and both reward carriers whose document and data machinery is industrialized.

items: Third-party handlers hold sensitive claims data with uneven controls; the carrier owns the headline risk.
FNOL, estimates, medical and police files arrive as documents; triage takes days and leakage hides in the queue.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, AI Security & Model Protection, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (FNOL and claims triage, Estimate review and leakage control, Commercial risk surveying) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — Rate filing regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
third-party tiers, access reviews and evidence automation (handler risk governed)
